name: Feedback Degradation Above Evaluator Capability
definition: Human or agent evaluation degrades precisely where the evaluated system is hardest to evaluate, including where it exceeds the evaluator.
trigger_conditions: Evaluators score outputs they cannot independently verify
The evaluated system is at or above evaluator capability in the domain
Evaluator agreement is used as the quality signal
citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F017 Feedback Degradation Above Evaluator Capability. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F017
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
